svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"collar-insignia-cap-metal","name":"CAP collar / lapel insignia, metal letters (cadet officers)","size_in":{"w":1.38,"h":0.5233},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,138,52.33],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The garment overlay garment-blues-class-a-cadet-officer-insignia reserves a 1.4 x 0.53 in zone for the CAP lapel letters (Fig A6-5 gives no dimension): letters 1.30 x 0.46 in plus 0.04 in margin","provenance":"letter shapes from the CAP block letters of build-epaulet-sleeves.js (traced from Fig A5-2); finish from Fig A6-5","colours":{"metal":"#d3d7dc","edge":"#8f969e"},"anchors":{"top_center":[69,0],"bottom_center":[69,52.3348365276212],"center":[69,26.1674182638106],"left_edge":[0,26.1674182638106],"right_edge":[138,26.1674182638106],"mount_center":[69,26.1674182638106]},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Class A / service coat, cadet officers","rule":"on each lapel halfway up the seam, resting on but not over it, letters parallel with the ground (4.1.5.2.2.1.2, 4.1.7.2.2.1, 4.1.9.4.1.2, 4.1.10.1.2.1)"}],"pair":{"count":2,"mirrored":false,"note":"identical on both lapels"},"documented":["CAP lapel insignia, cadet officers; metal chevrons replace it for cadet NCOs and Airmen"],"assumed":["size"],"grade":"rank-insignia","see_also":"rank-collar-cap-officers.* (cadet officer collar / cap grade pieces) is a different set and is not duplicated here","fit":{"method":"n/a","score":null}}
